business_summary: Indian Oil Corporation Limited (NSE: IOC) is India's largest refiner. It sits on the russian-diesel-ban chain's refinery-capacity-response link, operating the country's biggest current capacity expansions at Panipat, Gujarat and Barauni, the Indian half of the non-Russian conversion capacity that eventually closes the distillate gap this chain trades. No SEC CIK exists for this NSE-India-only listing (REQ-20260904-97/98 fulfilled), so all fundamentals rest on the yfinance-statements vendor block, current through FY2026 (year ended March), with all 12 canonical fields computable.

exposure_summary.narrative: INDIAN-OIL has 1 placement on russian-diesel-ban (refinery-capacity-response, UNDISCOVERED, not money-corner). Panipat, Gujarat and Barauni are specific, sourced capacity expansions, but no percentage of Indian Oil's total revenue attributable to those three refineries alone is disclosed or sourced this run.
